attribution.note: Marcus states and endorses this assessment in his own argument.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the firm cost prediction, company-size qualifier, and qualified background about competitive outcomes.

contract.note: Financial immateriality and continued AI activity are ordinary readings of trivial costs being absorbed. The competitive-effect interpretation is reasonable, although materiality and the covered proposals remain unspecified.

evidence.note: Dated opposing analysis relevant to regulatory burdens, but its projected national GDP and employment effects do not measure realized company compliance costs or US-China capability effects.

reviews.rationale: No deadline was supplied. The packet establishes neither company-specific material compliance costs nor credible causal competitive effects. The opposing projections do not meet the early-resolution rule, so the forecast remains unresolved.

attribution.note: Marcus makes this prediction himself; it is not attributed to the commentators he discusses.

semantics.note: The normalization omits the governing continuation-of-trends condition and fails to explicitly restrict national advantage to the US-China comparison.

contract.note: The contract fairly restores the condition and US-China capability scope. Its qualitative reading is ordinary, and it appropriately requires independent evidence of the antecedent without inventing a deadline.

evidence.note: Observed ranking changes support limited convergence and catch-up through March 2026. They do not establish practical capability parity, continued similarity of methods and data, or the unrestricted forecast.
The pre-cutoff estimate of a 6.5-month US lead cautions against inferring parity from rankings. It does not establish a substantial sustained advantage under the stated condition.

reviews.rationale: The contract repairs the omitted condition, but the packet does not establish that condition independently. Ranking convergence offers limited support, while the alternative lead estimate is inconclusive. With no deadline or qualifying conclusive event, the conditional forecast cannot yet be scored.
